title: Babur Enters the Heavenly Court by Satnam

blocks.text: Guru Nanak now equips Babur for a visionary ascent rather than a political bargain. He teaches him the repetition of satnam and marks him for the journey, turning the emperor's request into an initiation that depends on remembrance instead of force.

Led upward toward the heavenly threshold, Babur discovers that rank alone gains him nothing. The gate opens when he invokes satnam, proving that even an emperor enters the higher court only by the Name rather than by sword, lineage, or command.

Inside, Babur beholds Guru Nanak's banner, devotional music, scripture, and radiant assembly in divine presence. The scene makes the hierarchy unmistakable: temporal empire may shake Hindustan, but Guru Nanak's sovereignty is already manifest in a court beyond earthly kingship.
